hook: They told you swallowed gum stays in your stomach for seven years.
twist: Most stomachs empty within two hours, gum included; the gum base is indigestible but takes the same path as food. Doctors rarely see swallowed gum more than a week old.
angle: Myth-buster: the Stomach is offended by the seven-year claim; the microbes saw it leave. One big number: 7 YEARS crossed out.
why_now: Scout: 'what happens when you swallow' Shorts top 35.2M views since mid-2024; the gum myth is the most-searched swallow question.
risks: Doctors warn that swallowing lots of gum (especially children) can cause a blockage: the description says so.
approved_by: user (launch slate, 2026-10-06: 'go ahead, do the whole process for all 12 videos')
